column3: フェリスを呼び出す
column4: He calls Feliss.

column3: ここはお前が詳しいだろう、元職場の一つだし、道案内しろ、近道ないのかとか
column4: You know this place well, it's one of your old workplaces. Guide the way, find out if there's a shortcut.

column3: あのね、私は悪魔からも指名手配されているのよ、見つかったら私もやばいのよ
column4: You know, I'm also wanted by the demons. If they find me, it's bad news for me too.

column3: その時は守ってやる。
column4: At that time, I'll protect you.

column3: えー・・、ちっとも信じてないフェリス、
column4: Eh... Feliss doesn't believe that at all.

column3: くすん、分かりましたやりますやればいいんでしょ・・
column4: Sniff, alright, I'll do it if I have to...

column3: でも・・なんか、今日は空気が変ね
column4: But... somehow, the atmosphere today is strange.

column3: ああ、確か上級悪魔ネプラカスが通るとか・・
column4: Ah, if I remember correctly, the high-level demon Neplacus is supposed to pass through...

column3: えっ・・フェリス蒼白
column4: Eh... Feliss turns pale.

column3: 接触したら駄目、危険　私達とは格が違う
column4: You can't come into contact with him, it's dangerous; he's on a totally different level than us.

column3: 上級も上級、第２級魔神です。
column4: An advanced one, an advanced one indeed, a second-rank demon god.

column3: ・・２流悪魔みたいで弱そうだが・・
column4: ...It looks weak like a second-rate demon, though...

column3: 違います、私が１番階級が高かった時で６級が限界だったし
column4: No, when I had the highest rank, sixth rank was the limit.

column3: それよりはるか上です、人間とかが手出し出来る範疇じゃないです
column4: It's far above that; it's beyond the range where humans can intervene.

column3: それに・・口ごもる　（　フェリスに酷い罰を与えた存在がネプラカス
column4: And... he hesitates to speak (Neplacus is the one who inflicted a harsh punishment on Feliss).

column3: 震えているフェリスの手を握り
column4: He holds the trembling hand of Feliss.

column3: 天使が来ても悪魔が来ても守ってやる、俺のおもちゃだからなお前は
column4: Whether angels or demons come, I'll protect you, because you are my toy after all.

column3: とランスが言っても微妙に聞こえてない、まだ震えてるフェリス、
column4: Even though Rance says that, Feliss only partially hears it and is still trembling.

column3: う、うう、どうせ言ったところで聞くような人じゃないし・・
column4: U-uh, anyway, he's not someone who would listen even if I said something...

column3: でも・・本当にネプラカスには近づかないで、お願いしますと真剣にお願い
column4: But... please, really don't get close to Neplacus, I earnestly ask you.

column3: あ、ああ・・さすがにちょっと押される
column4: Ah, yeah... I'm being pushed back a bit, as expected.
